items.title: Dipole moment aur molecules ki polarity (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the unnumbered Dipole Moment topic, printed pages 51-52.

blocks.text: HF jaise compounds mein, jahan bandhe hue atoms mukhtalif anasir ke hain, atoms ke darmiyan electron taqseem na-hamwar hai, to ek atom par juzvi (partial) musbat charge aur doosre par juzvi manfi charge hota hai. Jis molecule ke ek hisse par delta+ aur doosre par delta- charge ho woh dipole hai, aur aise molecule ka dipole moment hota hai. Dipole moment bond ya molecule ki polarity ka miqdari (quantitative) paimana hai. HF, HCl, HBr, HI aur NO jaise diatomic molecules ke dipole moments musbat sire (delta+) se manfi sire (delta-) ki taraf hote hain; HF mein electron density fluorine atom ke qareeb zyada hai aur moment H se F ki taraf hai. Dipole moment debye unit (D) mein napa jata hai; zyada dipole moment zyada polarity ka matlab hai.

Do se zyada atoms wale compounds mein dipole moment molecule ki banawat par munhasir hai. Pani ka dipole moment 1.85 D hai, do hydrogen atoms wale sire se oxygen atom wale sire ki taraf. Seedhe H-O-H molecule ka dipole moment sifar hota, to ghair-sifar qeemat dikhati hai ke pani ghair-khatti (non-linear) hai; tajurbe v-shaped banawat zahir karte hain. SO2 ka dipole moment 1.61 D hai, pani ke ulat simt mein. H2S bhi non-linear hai: us ke bonds polar hain aur cancel nahi hote, to molecule ka dipole moment hai.

Kuch molecules ka dipole moment sifar hota hai kyunke un ki banawat ka tawazun (symmetry) alag alag bond moments cancel kar deta hai. BeCl2 seedha (linear) hai, darmiyani atom ke dono taraf 180 degrees par do ek jaise chlorine atoms, to Be-Cl bond moments, barabar aur mukhalif, cancel ho jate hain. CCl4 ke chaar C-Cl bonds C aur Cl ke bare electronegativity farq se bohat polar hone chahiyein, magar chaar bond moments is tarah simt mein hain ke cancel ho jate hain; kul dipole moment sifar hai aur molecule non-polar aur bilkul tetrahedral. BF3 ki mutawazan trigonal planar banawat hai aur us ka dipole moment bhi sifar. Qaida yeh hai ke jin molecules mein ek jaise ligands (darmiyani atom ke saath atoms ya atomon ke giroh) ba-qaida geometry mein hon, alag alag bond moments sifar na bhi hon to poore molecule ka dipole moment sifar hota hai aur woh non-polar hai.

blocks.prompt: Wazahat karein ke CO ka dipole moment kyun hai magar CO2 ka nahi, aur kya CCl4 ke C-Cl bonds polar hain jabke molecule nahi.
blocks.explanation: CO do mukhtalif atoms ka diatomic molecule hai, to us ka akela bond polar hai aur molecule dipole hai. CO2 seedha hai, O=C=O: us ke do polar C=O moments barabar aur mukhalif hain aur cancel ho jate hain, to molecule ka dipole moment nahi. CCl4 mein har C-Cl bond polar hai kyunke chlorine carbon se kahin zyada electronegative hai, magar chaar bonds ba-qaida tetrahedron ke konon ki taraf hain aur un ke moments cancel hote hain, to molecule non-polar hai.

items: Dipole ke delta+ aur delta- sire hote hain; us ka dipole moment (debye, D) polarity napta hai aur delta+ se delta- ki taraf hota hai (HF mein H se F).
Shakal kul moment tai karti hai: mure H2O (1.85 D) aur SO2 (1.61 D) polar hain; mutawazan BeCl2, BF3, CCl4 aur CH4 ka moment sifar hai aur woh non-polar hain.
